caption: The drawing features a single wooden object, which appears to be a cylindrical cup or shallow pot with an elongated, tapering handle attached to one side. The cup is light brown and has a wood grain texture. The handle, also light brown with visible wood texture, is attached at an angle and has a smooth, rounded shape that gets thinner and more pointed at the end. The attachment point is reinforced with a small, circular metallic fastener, and the wall of the cup has a vertical seam marked by a line of small, regularly spaced red dots or rivets. To the left of the object, there is a monogram "DM" set against a brushstroke of shaded background. The composition is centered on a plain, beige background framed by a double-line border, and the artist's name "Duball" is written in small text near the bottom right corner.
title: Shaker Wooden Dipper
